title: The Elevator Man
premise_public: A man lives on the 10th floor but usually takes the elevator only to the 7th, walking the rest, unless it rains.
solution_summary: He is short; can't reach the 10th-floor button. On rainy days he uses an umbrella to press it.

facts.text: He cannot reach the 10th-floor button with his finger.
On rainy days he carries an umbrella.
He uses the umbrella tip to reach the button.

acceptable_solutions: He's short and uses an umbrella to press 10
He can't reach the button; umbrella helps when it rains
hints: Weather adds an object that helps.
